definitions.gloss: setta; flat sandals with a leather sole
definitions.explanation: Flat Japanese sandals with a woven bamboo-sheath or rush top and a leather sole, often with a small metal plate at the heel. Worn mainly by men with kimono, and associated with a stylish, traditional look.

examples.japanese: {雪駄|せった}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雪駄|せった}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather went out in a kimono and setta sandals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石畳|いしだたみ}→石畳：08398_ishidatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{雪駄|せった}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かかと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金具|かなぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ちゃらちゃら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: As he walked along the stone-paved street, the metal heel plates of his setta clinked.

notes:
The verb is ⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧, as for all footwear. Like ⟦{草履|ぞうり}→草履：04048_zouri⟧ and ⟦{下駄|げた}→下駄：03984_geta⟧, it is held on by a ⟦{鼻緒|はなお}→鼻緒：15379_hanao⟧ between the toes.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草履|ぞうり}→草履：04048_zouri⟧: zori — the general word for flat thonged sandals; {雪駄|せった} is a leather-soled kind
- ⟦{下駄|げた}→下駄：03984_geta⟧: geta — wooden clogs raised on two teeth
